senses.gloss:
प्रशँय्युवाक प्रशंय्यु-वाक, अस्, m., see
Vārttika 1. to Pāṇ. II. 4, 29.

प्रशंस् प्र-शंस्, cl. 1. P. -शंसति, -शंसि-
तुम् (anomalous 3rd sing. Pot. प्र-शंसीयात्), to
[]
praise forth, praise, eulogize, laud, extol, commend,
recommend; to approve; to esteem, value; to de-
clare; (with न) to disapprove, blame, censure.

प्र-शंसक, अस्, इका, अम्, praising, commending,
eulogizing, laudatory, flattering; a praiser.

प्र-शंसन, अम्, n. praising, eulogizing; (some-
times incorrectly spelt प्र-शंशन.)

प्र-शंसनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-
worthy, laudable, commendable.

प्र-शंसा, f. praise, commendation, panegyric,
eulogy, applause, flattery; fame, reputation, glory
[cf. स्त्री-प्˚]; अप्रस्तुत-प्रशंसा, indirect de-
scription, a description of anything implied by the
description of a similar or contrary object; (some-
times incorrectly spelt प्र-शंशा.)
—प्रशंसा-
मुखर, अस्, आ, अम्, loud with praise, praising
loudly.
—प्रशंसामुखरानन (˚र-आन्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, ‘one whose mouth is loud with praise,’
speaking loudly in praise (of anything).
—प्रशंसो-
पमा (˚सा-उप्˚), f. laudatory comparison, comparing
to anything superior.

प्र-शंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, commended,
eulogized, extolled, applauded.

प्र-शंसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or
commended, praiseworthy, laudable, commendable.

प्र-शंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, praising, commending,
eulogizing.

प्र-शंस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-
worthy, laudable; [cf. प्र-शस्तव्य.]

प्र-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, commended;
eulogized, extolled; laudable, commendable, admir-
able, excellent, good, best; happy; well; right;
(अस्), m., N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a river.
—प्रशस्त-कर, अस्, m., N. of an author (per-
haps the writer of a work entitled Pra-śasta).
—प्र-
शस्त-कलश, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—प्रशस्त-
ता, f. or प्रशस्त-त्व, अम्, n. excellence, goodness.
—प्रशस्त-पाद, अस्, m., N. of an author.
—प्र-
शस्ताद्रि (˚त-अद्˚), इस्, m., N. of a mountain to
the west of Madhya-deśa.
प्रशस्त प्र-शस्त, &c. See p. 645, col. 3.

प्र-शस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-
worthy; [cf. प्र-शंस्तव्य.]

प्र-शस्ति, इस्, f. praise, eulogy, fame; glorification,
benediction; excellence, eminence; instruction, con-
duct, guidance; an edict (?) ; प्रशस्तिं धा, to bestow
praise upon, speak highly of, value highly (with loc.).
—प्रशस्ति-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. bestowing praise, prais-
ing.
—प्रशस्ति-प्रकाशिका, f., N. of a work.
—प्र-
शस्ति-रत्नावली, f., N. of a poem by Viśva-nātha.

1. प्र-शस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or com-
mended, praiseworthy, laudable, commendable; ex-
cellent, eminent, distinguished; to be called happy,
to be congratulated; [cf. प्र-शंस्य.]
—प्रशस्य-
ता, f. excellence, eminence.
2. प्र-शस्य, ind. having praised or recommended.
प्रशक प्र-शक. See under प्र-शाख.
प्राशक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who eats, an eater.
प्रासक, अस्, m. a die, dice.

प्रशद् प्र-शद्, Caus. P. -शातयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to fall down, break off, pluck, gather.

प्रसद् प्र-सद्, cl. 1. 6. P. -सीदति, -सत्तुम्,
to settle down, become clear, become placid or
tranquil, become calm, be calm, be soothed; to be
content or satisfied; to be glad; to be gracious
or propitious, to be favourable, favour (with gen.);
to vouchsafe, be pleased to (with inf.): Caus. -सा-
दयति, -यितुम्, to render calm, soothe, appease,
propitiate; to beg pardon of (with acc.); (A.) to
cause to be gracious, pray for grace or favour: Pass.
of Caus. -साद्यते, to be rendered calm, to be
soothed or appeased.
प्र-शत्त्वन्, आ, m. the ocean; (अरी), f. a river.

प्रशम् प्र-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमि-
तुम्, to become calm or tranquil, to be still or
unmoved; to be appeased or pacified, be soothed;
to be laid or made to settle down (as dust); to be
restrained; to become extinguished; to cease; to
fade away: Caus. -शमयति, -यितुम्, to tranquillize,
make calm or tranquil, pacify, soothe, appease; to
extinguish, quench, allay; to kill, destroy; -शाम-
यति, -यितुम्, to make subject, make obedient,
subdue, conquer, tranquillize.
प्र-शाम्, न्, न्, न्, tranquil, quiet.

प्र-शम, अस्, m. becoming calm or tranquil,
rest, quiet, quiescence, calmness, tranquillity, peace,
composure (e. g. प्रशमम् उपैहि, go to com-
posure, i. e. compose yourself); assuagement, ap-
peasement, tranquillizing, removing; becoming ex-
tinguished, extinction (of flames &c.), abatement;
N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi and Śānti-devā;
[]
(ई), f., N. of an Apsaras.
—प्रशमङ्-कर, अस्, ई,
अम्, causing the cessation of.
—प्रशम-स्थित, अस्,
आ, अम्, being in a state of quiescence.
—प्रशमायन
(˚म-अय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, walking in tranquillity.

प्र-शाम, अस्, m. tranquillity, quiescence; paci-
fying; laying, suppressing.

प्र-शमन, अस्, ई, अम्, tranquillizing, pacifying,
calming; suppressing, curing, healing; (अम्), n.
reposing, repose, quiescence; tranquillizing, pacifying,
calming; mitigating, assuaging, allaying, composing;
soothing (fever &c.); curing, healing; extinguish-
ing, quenching, suppressing; abatement, cessation;
killing, destroying, slaughter; (scil. अस्त्रम्), N. of
a magic weapon; bestowing aptly or fitly (Manu
VII. 56, = सत्-पात्रे प्रतिपादनम्); securing,
keeping safe; लब्धस्य प्रशमनम्, the se-
curing of what has been acquired or bestowing it
on fit objects; [cf. लब्ध-प्˚.]

प्र-शमय्य, ind. having appeased or tranquil-
lized.

प्र-शमित, अस्, आ, अम्, tranquillized, appeased,
relieved; quelled, quenched, allayed.
—प्रशमितो-
पद्रव (˚त-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having all calamities
or hinderances quelled (= प्रशान्त-बाध).

प्र-शम्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being tranquillized
or pacified, being appeased; being flattered.

प्र-शान्, ind., see Gaṇa Svar-ādi to Pāṇ. I. 1,
37; [cf. प्र-शाम्.]

प्र-शान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, tranquillized, composed,
quieted, calmed, calm; tamed; subdued; abated,
ended, ceased, discontinued (as active effort); dead,
deceased; relieved; (अस्), m., N. of a divinity.
—प्रशान्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose desires
are calmed, content.
—प्रशान्त-चारित्र-मति, इस्,
m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—प्रशान्त-चारिन्, इणस्,
m. pl. walking tranquilly, (perhaps) an epithet of a
class of deities.
—प्रशान्त-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, one
whose efforts have ceased, resting.
—प्रशान्त-ता, f.
tranquillity (of mind).
—प्रशान्त-बाध, अस्, आ,
अम्, having all calamities or hinderances quelled (=
प्रशमितोपद्रव).
—प्रशान्तात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚),
आ, आ, अ, ‘tranquil-souled,’ composed in mind, peace-
ful, calm.
—प्रशान्तोर्ज (˚त-ऊर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one
whose strength has ceased, weakened, prostrated.
—प्रशान्तौजस् (˚त-ओज्˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, = प्रशान्-
तोर्ज above.
प्रशान्त प्र-शान्त, &c. See above.
प्रशान्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-शान्त above.

प्र-शान्ति, इस्, f. becoming calm or tranquil, tran-
quillization, tranquillity of mind, calm, quiet, pacifi-
cation, composure; ceasing, cessation, rest; allaying,
quenching, extinguishing, extinction.
—प्रशान्ति-
दूती, f. the harbinger of rest, forerunner of repose,
an epithet of old age.

प्रशर्ध प्र-शर्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शृध्
with प्र), Ved. valiant (said of Indra; Sāy. = प्र-
कर्षेणाभिभविता).

प्रशल प्रशल, a various reading for प्र-
सल, q. v.

प्रसल प्रसल, अस्, m. the cold season,
winter (= हेमन्त; also read प्रशल).

प्रशस् प्र-शस्, अस्, f. (fr. rt. शस् with प्र),
Ved. a hatchet, axe, knife; (according to others) =
प्र-शस्त, प्रशस्त-च्छेदन.

प्रशास् प्र-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्,
to rule over, reign over, rule, reign, govern, com-
mand, enjoin; to teach, instruct; to chastise, punish.

प्रशाख प्र-शाख, अस्, आ, अम्, having great
branches (as a tree); an epithet of the fifth stage in
the formation of an embryo (in which the hands
and feet are formed, in this sense also written प्र-
शक); (आ), f. a branch, small branch or twig;
(probably) the extremities of the body.
—प्रशाख-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having many branches.
प्रशाखिका, f. a branch; a small branch or twig.

प्र-शासन, अम्, n. governing, ruling; dominion,
government; enjoining, enacting.

प्र-शासित, अस्, आ, अम्, ruled over, reigned over,
governed, ruled; enjoined, enacted.

प्र-शासितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, governing, ruling, a
governor, ruler.

प्र-शास्तृ, ता, m. ‘director,’ title of a priest also
called Maitrāvaruṇa, the first assistant of the Hotṛ
(Ved.); a king.

प्राशास्त्र प्राशास्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-शास्तृ),
the office of the Pra-śāstṛ, q. v.; government, rule,
dominion.

प्र-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ruled over, reigned,
governed, commanded.
प्र-शिष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. injunction, command, order.

प्र-शिस्, ईस्, f., Ved. injunction, command, order;
[cf. 1. आ-शिस्.]

प्रशिथिल प्र-शिथिल, अस्, आ, अम्, very loose,
relaxed, lax.
—प्रशिथिली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered
very loose, greatly loosened.
—प्रशिथिली-भूत, अस्,
आ, अम्, become loose or lax.

प्रशिष प्रशिष, अस्, m., N. of a man;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.

प्रशिष्य प्र-शिष्य, अस्, m. the disciple of
a disciple, scholar of a scholar, pupil of a pupil.
—प्रशिष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being the disciple of
a disciple, the condition of a pupil's pupil.

प्रशुक्रीय प्रशुक्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. be-
ginning with the words प्र शुक्रा (said of the
hymn Ṛg-veda VII. 34, 1).

प्रशुद्धि प्र-शुद्धि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. शुध् with
प्र), purity, clearness.

प्रशुम्भ् प्र-शुम्भ्, cl. 6. A. -शुम्भते,
-शुम्भितुम्, Ved. to decorate or adorn one's self
highly; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण स्वकीयम् अङ्गम्
अलङ्-कृ.

प्रशुश्रुक प्र-शुश्रुक, अस्, m., N. of a prince
(a son of Maru; cf. प्र-सुश्रुत).

प्रशोचन प्र-शोचन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शुच्
with प्र), Ved. burning on, continuing to burn.

प्रशोष प्र-शोष, अस्, m. (rt. शुष्), drying
up, becoming dry, exsiccating, aridity.

प्र-शोषण, अस्, m. ‘drying up,’ epithet of a
kind of phantom.

प्रश्चुत् प्र-श्चुत् or प्र-श्च्युत्, cl. 1. A. -श्चो-
तति, -श्च्योतति, -श्चोतितुम्, -श्च्योतितुम्, to pour forth,
shed, distil, sprinkle; to drip, fall in drops.

प्र-श्चोतत् or प्र-श्च्योतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pouring
forth, sprinkling; dripping, falling in drops.

प्रश्न 1. प्रश्न, अस्, m. basket-work, a
plaited basket.

प्रश्न 2. प्रश्न, अस्, m. (fr. rt. प्रछ्), a
question, demand, inquiry, interrogation, query [cf.
कुशुल-प्˚]; judicial inquiry or examination [cf.
साक्षि-प्˚]; a controverted question, point at issue,
subject of inquiry, controversy, (प्रश्नम् प्र-ब्रू,
to decide a controverted point; प्रश्नम् इ, to lay
a question before any one (acc.) for decision; प्रश्-
नस् तव पितरि, the point at issue is before thy
father, i. e. it is submitted to him to decide); a
problem for calculation; inquiry into the future (in
astrology; cf. दिव्य-प्˚, देव-प्˚, दैव-प्˚); a par-
ticular number of verses of the Veda repeated from
memory by a pupil to his Guru, a task, lesson, repeti-
tion; a term applied to short sections in various works.
—प्रश्न-कोष्ठी, f., N. of a work on divination.
—प्रश्न-दूती, f. a riddle, enigma, perplexing or
enigmatical question.
—प्रश्न-विवाक, अस्, m., Ved.
one who decides controversies, an arbitrator.
—प्रश्-
न-विवाद, अस्, m. a controverted question, contro-
versy.
—प्रश्न-वैष्णव, अम्, n., N. of an
astrological work.
—प्रश्न-व्याकरण, अम्, n.,
N. of the tenth of the twelve sacred books of the
Jainas.
—प्रश्नार्णव (˚न-अर्˚), अस्, m. ‘ocean of
questions,’ N. of a work on astrology (= वैष्णव-
शास्त्र).
—प्रश्नोत्तर (˚न-उत्˚), अस् or अम्, m. or
[]
n. (?), a particular Śabdālaṅkāra or figure of speech.
—प्रश्नोत्तर-मणि-माला or प्रश्नोत्तर-माला,
f., N. of a work.
—प्रश्नोत्तर-रत्न-माला, f.,
N. of a work.
—प्रश्नोपनिषद् (˚न-उप्˚), त्, f.,
N. of an Upaniṣad (consisting of six questions and
six answers).

प्रस्न प्र-स्न, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्ना with प्र),
a bath, vessel for bathing.

प्रश्नय, Nom. P. प्रश्नयति, -यितुम्, to
inquire after, ask about (with two acc.).

प्रश्निन्, ई, m., Ved. an inquirer, one who inquires
into the future (Mahī-dhara = शकुनादि-प्रष्टृ).

प्रष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or questioned
about (with acc.); deserving to be consulted; proper
to be inquired into.
प्रष्टव्य प्रष्टव्य, प्रष्टृ. See above.

प्रष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, asking, demanding, an asker,
inquirer, questioner, interrogator, querist.

प्रश्नि प्रश्नि, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a race of
Ṛṣis; (incorrectly for पृश्नि, q. v.)
प्रश्नी, f. incorrectly for पृश्नी, q. v.

प्रश्रथ प्र-श्रथ, अस्, m. or प्र-श्रन्थन,
अम्, n. (fr. rt. श्रन्थ् with प्र), laxity, relaxation,
flaccidity.

प्रश्रब्धि प्र-श्रब्धि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. श्रम्भ्
with प्र), trust, confidence.

प्रश्रय प्र-श्रय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रि with
प्र), respectful demeanour, affection, regard, solicit-
ation, affection, respect, courtesy, civility, modesty;
Modesty personified as a son of Dharma and Hrī.
—प्रश्रय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, = प्रश्रयिन् below.

प्र-श्रयण, अम्, n. respectful demeanour, civi-
lity, modesty.

प्रश्रयिन्, ई, इणी, इ, behaving respectfully, cour-
teous, civil; modest.
—प्रश्रयि-ता, f. respectful
demeanour, courtesy, civility, modesty.

प्र-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, modest, humble, well-
behaved; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi
and Śānti-devā.

प्रश्रवण प्र-श्रवण, an incorrect form
for प्र-स्रवण, q. v.

प्र-स्रवण, अम्, n. (often incorrectly written
प्र-श्रवण), flowing forth, gushing out, oozing
out, trickling, dripping, leaking; dripping or fall of
water, a cascade, cataract; a fountain, spring, well;
a spout, the projecting mouth of a vessel (out of
which any fluid is poured); streaming forth of the
milk from the breast or udder; a pool of water
formed by mountain streams; washing away of
rocks &c. by the dripping of water; sweat, perspi-
ration; voiding urine; N. of a place where the
Sarasvatī takes its rise, (also प्लाक्षम् प्रस्रव-
णम्); (अस्), m., N. of a man; of a range of moun-
tains on the confines of Malaya.
प्राश्रवण प्राश्रवण. See प्रास्रवण.

प्रास्रवण प्रास्रवण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
स्रवण), coming or derived from a spring or
fountain (as water); (अस्), m. a patronymic from
Pra-sravaṇa; प्लक्षः प्रास्रवणः, N. of a
place, the source of the Sarasvatī or the spot where
the Sarasvatī reappears [cf. सरस्-वती]; (also spelt
प्राश्रवण.)

प्रश्रवस् प्र-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. ‘loud-
sounding,’ an epithet of the Maruts; (Sāy.) = प्र-
कृष्टान्न, having or bestowing excellent food.

प्रश्लथ प्र-श्लथ, अस्, आ, अम्, very loose,
greatly relaxed, languid, flaccid; unnerved.

प्रश्लित प्र-श्लित, अस्, m. (for प्र-श्रित), a
term applied to the rule of Sandhi according to
which अस् before a soft letter is changed into ओ.

प्रश्लिष्ट प्र-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्लिष्
with प्र), twisted, entwined; (अस्), m. a term
applied to the Sandhi of the vowel अ with a following
vowel and of other vowels with homogeneous vowels;
also to the vowel resulting from this Sandhi and of
the accent with which such a vowel is pronounced;
(अस्), m., N. of a man (?) .

प्राश्लिष्ट प्राश्लिष्ट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
श्लिष्ट; in Ved. gram.) N. of a kind of Svarita
produced by the combination of two short इस्; (also
wrongly read प्राक्-श्लिष्ट.)

प्र-श्लेष, अस्, m. close contact, pressing against;
euphonic coalition of vowels.

प्रश्वसितव्य प्र-श्वसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr.
rt. श्वस् with प्र), Ved. to be caused to recover
the breath.

प्र-श्वास, अस्, m. breathing in, inhaling, breath,
respiration.

प्रष्टि प्रष्टि, इस्, m. (connected with
पृष्टि, q. v.), Ved. a horse harnessed at the side,
a side-horse or one harnessed outside the shafts by
the side of the other yoke-horses [cf. दक्षिणा-प्˚];
(perhaps) a horse in front of those harnessed to the
yoke or to the chariot-pole [cf. अधि-प्रष्टि-युग];
(according to Sāy.) = वाहन-त्रय-मध्य-वर्ती
युग-विशेषः, a sort of yoke in the middle of
three horses; a bystander, companion (Sāy. = पार्श्व-
स्थ).
—प्रष्टि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having
side-horses (as a chariot).
—प्रष्टि-वाहन, अस्, आ,
अम्, or प्रष्टि-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. (a chariot)
drawn by side-horses (and thus having at least three
horses).

प्रष्ठ प्र-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्था with
प्र), standing in front, preceding, prior; chief, prin-
cipal, best [cf. रथ-प्˚]; a leader, conductor; (अस्),
m. a species of plant; (ई), f. the wife of a leader or
chief.
—प्रष्ठ-वाह्, ट्, m. a young bull or steer
training for the plough; प्रष्ठौही, f. a cow for
the first time with calf; [cf. पष्ठ-वाह्.]

प्रष्ठिवाहिन् प्रष्ठि-वाहिन्, a wrong read-
ing for प्रष्टि-वाहिन्, q. v.

प्रष्णवैष्णव प्रष्ण-वैष्णव, an incorrect
form for प्रश्न-वैष्णव, q. v.

प्रस् प्रस्, cl. 1. A. प्रसते, प्रसितुम्, to
extend, expand, spread, diffuse; to bring
forth young.

प्राश् 1. प्राश् (प्र-अश्, see rt. 1. अश्), cl. 5.
P. A. प्राश्नोति, प्राश्नुते, प्राशितुम्, Ved. to
arrive at, reach, (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण व्य्-आप्); to
fall to the lot or share of any one (with acc.).

प्राश् 2. प्राश् (प्र-अश्, see rt. 2. अश्), cl. 9.
P. A. प्राश्नाति, प्राश्नीते, प्राशितुम्, to begin to
eat, begin eating; to take into the mouth; taste
(Manu II. 62); to eat, consume, devour; (A.) to
drink; to enjoy, sport with, dally with (with inst.):
Pass. प्राश्यते, to be fed: Caus. प्राशयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to eat or devour, give to eat, feed.
3. प्राश्, ट्, f., Ved. food, provisions.

प्रास् 1. प्रास् (प्र-अस्, see rt. 1. अस्), cl. 2.
P. प्रास्ति, &c., Ved. to be in front of, be in an
especial manner or extraordinary degree; to be pre-
eminent, excel, preponderate, (Sāy. = प्र-भू.)

प्रास् 2. प्रास् (प्र-अस्, see rt. 2. अस्), cl. 4.
P. प्रास्यति, प्रासितुम्, to throw forth, cast away,
hurl forth, fling forth; to throw, cast, discharge (a
missile); अंशम् प्रास्, to cast lots.

प्रसक्त प्र-सक्त, प्र-सक्ति. See under
प्र-सञ्ज् below.

प्र-सक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to, in contact
with, united to, connected with; cleaving to, adher-
ing to, fixed upon (with loc.); devoted to; accom-
panying; engaged in, applied to, used, employed;
attained, obtained, gained; continual, constant, eter-
nal; opened, expanded; (अम्), ind. continually, in-
cessantly, eternally, ever.
प्र-सक्त; add — occurred, happened, taken place.
प्रसक्षिन् प्र-सक्षिन्. See p. 648, col. 1.

प्र-सक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. overpowering, de-
feating, victorious (Sāy. = शत्रूणाम् प्रसहन-
शीलः).

प्रसङ्ख्या 1. प्र-सङ्-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति,
-ख्यातुम्, to count or reckon up, number, enume-
rate, calculate.
2. प्र-सङ्ख्या, f. total number, sum; reflection.

प्र-सङ्ख्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, meditating (? as an
epithet of an order of ascetics); (अस्), m. payment,
liquidation; a sum of money; (अम्), n. enumerat-
ing, enumeration; reflection, meditation; reputation,
renown.
—प्रसङ्ख्यान-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, en-
grossed or absorbed in meditation.
प्रसङ्ग प्र-सङ्ग. See below.

प्र-सङ्ग, अस्, m. adherence or attachment to,
devotion to, devotedness; addiction to [cf. सुरत-
प्˚]; occupation [cf. विरत-प्˚, विरुद्ध-प्˚]; con-
nection, union, association, intercourse [cf. स्त्री-प्˚];
illicit intercourse; connected reasoning or argument;
connected language or style; subject, topic, the case
as stated; occurrence of a possibility, contingency,
case, event (e. g. एचः प्लुत-प्रसङ्गे, in the event
of a diphthong being prolated); conjuncture, occa-
sion, circumstances, time; introduction, insertion;
mention of parents; conjoint result (?); revealing a
secret (?); second or subsidiary incident (?); N. of a Bud-
dhist school; of a man; प्रसङ्गेन or प्रसङ्गात्,
ind. through connection with or relation to; with all
the heart, heartily, earnestly; on the occasion of,
in consequence of, on account of, because of (lit.
from its happening); when the occasion presents
itself, occasionally, incidentally; in the course of
(e. g. कथा-प्रसङ्गेन, in course of conversation).
—प्रसङ्ग-तस्, ind. out of attachment to or
respect for; = प्रसङ्गेन, प्रसङ्गात्.
—प्र-
सङ्ग-निवारण, अम्, n. the prevention of (similar)
[]
cases, obviation of (like future) contingencies.
—प्र-
सङ्ग-रत्नावली, f., N. of a work.
—प्रसङ्ग-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, occasional, incidental, casual.
—प्र-
सङ्ग-वशात्, ind. according to the time, as occasion
may demand, by the force of circumstances.
—प्र-
सङ्ग-विनिवृत्ति, इस्, f. the non-recurrence of a case.
—प्रसङ्ग-सम, अस्, m. a particular Jāti [q. v.]
in logic.
—प्रसङ्गाभरण (˚ग-आभ्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of a modern poetical anthology.

प्रासङ्ग प्रासङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-सङ्ग), a
kind of yoke for cattle.
प्रसङ्घ प्र-सङ्घ, अस्, m. a great multitude.

प्रसञ्चक्ष् प्र-सञ्-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, &c.
(see rt. चक्ष्), to reckon up, recount, enumerate.

प्रसञ्ज् प्र-सञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. -सजति, -सङ्क्तुम्,
to become attached to, feel affection for: Pass. -सज्-
यते, to cleave to, adhere or cling to, become fixed
upon or attached to, become strongly addicted to
(with loc.); to be relevant or applicable, to apply.
प्र-सक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached to.

प्र-सक्ति, इस्, f. adherence or attachment to, ad-
hesion, devotion to, addiction to, engagedness, the
being occupied with; bearing upon, applicability,
application (especially of a rule in grammar; अति-
प्रसक्ति, too wide applicability; प्रसक्तिम् प्र-या,
to become attached); connection, union, association;
inference, conclusion, deduction; a topic or subject
of conversation; occurrence of a possibility; perse-
verance, energy; acquiring, acquisition.

प्रसङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, attached to, devoted to;
dependent on, contingent, additional; occasional,
incidental; secondary, subordinate, non-essential.
—प्रसङ्गि-ता, f. attachment, addiction to, con-
nection, intercourse with.

प्र-सज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached to, to be
connected with; applicable.
—प्रसज्य-प्रतिषे-
ध, अस्, m. a particular kind of negation, negation
of a possible case (distinguished from पर्य्-उदास,
q. v.), a simple prohibition of the particular matter
specified without enjoining what is different.

प्र-सञ्जन, अम्, n. the act of attaching or con-
necting, combining, uniting; applying, employing,
bringing into use, bringing to bear.

प्र-सत्ति, इस्, f. transparency, brightness, clearness,
cleanness, purity; complacency, graciousness, favour.

प्र-सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, settled down, tranquil;
clear, bright, pellucid, limpid, pure, clean; soothed,
propitiated, pleased, delighted; gracious, propitious,
kind, kindly disposed towards, favourable, compla-
cent; true; (अस्), m., N. of a prince; (आ), f. pro-
pitiating, pleasing; spirituous or vinous liquor.
—प्र-
सन्न-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, almost quiet, tolerably
calm.
—प्रसन्न-ता, f. or प्रसन्न-त्व, अम्, n.
brightness, pellucidness, clearness, purity; favour,
kindness, propitiousness, good humour.
—प्रसन्न-
पाद, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?) , N. of a work by
Dharma-kīrtti.
—प्रसन्न-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्,
‘placid-countenanced,’ having a pleased or approv-
ing countenance, agreeable-looking, looking pleased,
smiling.
—प्रसन्न-राघव, अम्, n., N. of a
drama by Jaya-deva.
—प्रसन्न-वेङ्कटेश्वर-
माहात्म्य (˚ट-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a legend in the
Bhaviṣyottara-Purāṇa.
—प्रसन्न-सलिल, अस्, आ,
अम्, having clear or limpid water.
—प्रसन्नात्मन्
(˚न-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, gracious-minded, propitious.
—प्रसन्नेरा (˚न-ईरा), f. spirituous liquor.

प्राशन, अम्, n. the act of eating, feeding upon,
tasting; causing to eat or taste [cf. अन्न-प्˚];
feeding (especially applied in Manu II. 29 to the cere-
mony of making an infant taste, for the first time, a
little honey and clarified butter); food, victuals;
अमृत-प्राशन, अस्, m. having nectar for food,
feeding on ambrosia, an immortal.

प्रासन, अम्, n. throwing forth, casting away;
throwing, casting; throwing down.

1. प्र-साद, अस्, m. clearness, brightness, pellucid-
ness, transparentness, limpidness, purity, cleanness
[cf. अम्बु-प्˚]; clearness of style, perspicuity; calm-
ness, tranquillity, absence of excitement, repose,
composure; serenity of disposition, good humour,
good temper; graciousness, propitiousness, favour,
kindness, kind behaviour [cf. दुष्-प्˚, दृक्-प्˚];
approbation; Kindness personified as a son of Dharma
and Maitrī; a propitiatory offering or gift, food
offered to a god (= प्रसाद-द्रव्य, प्रसादान्न);
the remnants of food presented to an idol or left by
a spiritual teacher (both of which any one may
freely appropriate to his own use); free gift, gratuity;
well-being, welfare; N. of a commentary on the
Prakriyā-kaumudī; प्रसादात्, abl. c. through the
kindness of, by the favour of.
—प्रसाद-दान,
अम्, n. a propitiatory gift, a gift in token of favour,
gift of food by a superior.
—प्रसाद-पट्ट, अस्,
m. a turban of honour (worn as a token of royal
favour).
—प्रसाद-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, not
caring for any one's favour; withdrawing favour
from any one (with gen.).
—प्रसाद-पात्र, अम्,
n. an object of favour.
—प्रसाद-पुरग, अस्, आ,
[]
अम्, inclined to favour, favourably inclined.
—प्र-
साद-प्रतिलब्ध, अस्, m., N. of a demon.
—प्र-
साद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pleased, delighted; gracious,
favourable.
—प्रसाद-वित्तक, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps
an incorrect form for प्रसाद-वित्तम), best ac-
quainted with the favour (of another), preferred to
all others.
—प्रसाद-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, abiding in
serenity, kind, propitious; happy.
—प्रसादान्तर
(˚द-अन्˚), अम्, n. another (mark of) favour.
—प्र-
सादी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to
bestow as a mark of favour, bestow graciously, present.

2. प्रसाद, Nom. P. प्रसादति, प्रसादितुम्, to
be clear or bright.
प्रसाद प्र-साद, &c. See प्र-सद्, p. 647.

प्रासाद प्रासाद, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-सद्), a
lofty seat or platform for spectators; a building
erected on high foundations and approached by
means of steps, a building consecrated to a deity or
inhabited by a prince, a temple, palace; the assembly
room and confessional hall of the Buddhist priest-
hood.
—प्रासाद-कुक्कुट, अस्, m. a domestic
pigeon.
—प्रासाद-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to (the
roof of) a palace.
—प्रासाद-तल, अम्, n. the flat
roof of a house or palace.
—प्रासाद-परामन्त्र,
अस्, m., N. of a particular magical formula (a com-
bination of the letters ह and स, = परा-प्रासाद-
मन्त्र).
—प्रासाद-पृष्ठ, अस्, m. a terrace or
balcony on the top of a large house.
—प्रासाद-प्र-
तिष्ठा, f. the consecration of a temple.
—प्रासाद-
प्रस्तर, अस्, m. the flat roof of a house.
—प्रासाद-
मण्डना, f. a kind of orpiment.
—प्रासाद-वासिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, dwelling in a palace.
—प्रासाद-शायिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, accustomed to sleep in a palace.
—प्रासाद-
शृङ्ग, अम्, n. the spire or pinnacle of a palace or
temple, a turret.
—प्रासाद-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, stand-
ing on (the roof of) a palace.
—प्रासादाग्र्य (˚द-
अग्˚), आणि, n. pl. the most excellent or beautiful
palaces.
—प्रासादाङ्गना (˚द-अङ्˚), f. the court-
yard of a temple, precincts^1 of a shrine.
—प्रासादा-
रोहण (˚द-आर्˚), अम्, n. the going up into a
palace, entering a palace.
—प्रासादारोहणीय, अस्,
आ, अम्, relating to the act of going up into a palace.

प्र-सादक, अस्, इका, अम्, clearing, purifying,
rendering clear or pellucid; gladdening, cheering,
exhilarating; propitiating, courting favour, wishing
to win any one's favour.

प्र-सादन, अस्, ई, अम्, rendering clear, purifying
[cf. अम्बु-प्˚, तोय-प्˚]; calming, tranquillizing;
soothing, cheering, gratifying; (अस्), m. a royal
tent; (आ), f. service, worship; (अम्), n. cleaning,
freeing from soil or impurities; the act of calming,
tranquillizing, composing, soothing (e. g. नेत्र-प्˚,
administering soothing remedies to the eyes); cheer-
ing, gratifying [cf. श्रुति-प्˚]; rendering gracious,
propitiating, pleasing, (त्वत्-प्रसादनात्, for the sake
of propitiating thee); boiled rice.

प्र-सादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious,
to be propitiated.

प्र-सादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to be gracious,
propitiating, gratifying, pleasing.

प्र-सादयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered
gracious, to be propitiated.

प्र-सादित, अस्, आ, अम्, purified, cleansed; pleased,
conciliated, propitiated, appeased, reconciled; wor-
shipped.

प्र-सादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, calming, tranquillizing,
soothing, cheering, gladdening; showing favour,
treating with kindness; clear, serene, bright.

प्र-साद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious,
to be propitiated, to be conciliated, placable.

प्र-सेदिवस्, वान्, दुषी, वत्, one who has be-
come pleased or propitiated, favourable.
प्रसेदिवस् प्र-सेदिवस्. See p. 647, col. 3.

प्रसन्धा प्र-सन्-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति,
-धत्ते, -धातुम्, to fix or fit (an arrow) to (the
bow-string).

प्र-सन्धान, अम्, n. combination (e. g. of
words in the Krama, q. v.).
प्र-सन्धि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Manu.
प्रसभम् प्र-सभम्. See p. 648, col. 1.

प्र-सभम्, ind. (an ind. past part. of a form
सभ् = सह्, cf. 2. प्र-सह्य), by force, forcibly,
violently; importunately; exceedingly, much; N. of
a variety of the Triṣṭubh metre.
—प्रसभ-द-
मन, अम्, n. forcible taming (of wild animals;
according to a Scholiast = बलात्कारेण मर्दनम्).
—प्रसभ-हरण, अम्, n. carrying off by force,
violent seizure.
—प्रसभोद्धृत (˚भ-उद्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, torn up by force, forcibly uprooted.
—प्र-
सभोद्धृतारि (˚त-अरि), इस्, इस्, इ, one who has
forcibly uprooted his enemies.

प्रसमीक्ष् प्र-सम्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते,
-ईक्षितुम्, to look at, look upon, observe, perceive,
see; to reflect upon, consider, deliberate; to ac-
knowledge, recognise as, regard as.

प्र-समीक्षण, अम्, n. considering, deliberat-
ing, discussing.
प्र-समीक्षा, f. deliberation, judgment.

प्र-समीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, looked
upon, observed; reflected upon, considered; regarded
as, declared.

1. प्र-समीक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be considered
or weighed or discussed.

2. प्र-समीक्ष्य, ind. having looked at; having
reflected upon, having considered.

प्रसमीडित प्र-समीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, praised,
celebrated.

प्रसयन प्र-सयन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सि with
प्र), binding, fastening.
प्रसित प्र-सित. See प्र-सयन, p. 647.

प्राशित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken into the mouth, tasted;
eaten, devoured, swallowed, well eaten; (अम्), n. an
offering of rice or water to the Manes of progenitors,
obsequies to deceased ancestors (Manu III. 74, =
पितृ-यज्ञाख्यं नित्य-श्राद्धम्).

1. प्र-सिति, इस्, f. (for 2. see p. 648, col. 2), a
ligament, binding, tie, fetter.

प्रसिति 2. प्र-सिति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. सो with
प्र; for 1. see प्र-सयन, p. 647), Ved. a track,
path, course (as of fire &c.); an attack, assault; a
throw, cast, shot; stretch, reach, extent, compass;
duration, series, succession (e. g. दीर्घाम् अनु प्र-
सितिम्, in long succession); dominion, power, autho-
rity, influence; (Sāy.) = ज्वाला, a flame; = बन्धन,
confinement.
प्रसर प्र-सर, &c. See प्र-सृ, p. 649.

प्र-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, moving forwards, proceeding,
projecting; (अम्), n. going forwards, unimpeded
motion, free course [cf. विच्छिन्न-धूम-प्˚];
spreading, extending, extension, extent, dimension,
diffusion, dispersion; expansion; a stream, flow,
flood, torrent; (in medicine) morbid displacement
of the humors of the body; multitude, assemblage;
a fight, combat, battle, war; an iron arrow; speed,
velocity; affectionate solicitation; (आ), f. the plant
Pæderia Fœtida.
—प्रसर-युत, अस्, आ, अम्, pos-
sessing extension, extensive.
प्रसार प्र-सार, &c. See प्र-सृ, p. 649.

प्र-सार, अस्, m. going forth, going about, spread-
ing, extending, extension, expansion; stretching out
[cf. बाहु-प्˚]; opening (the mouth); going out to
forage, spreading over the country for grass and fuel.

प्रसर्ग प्र-सर्ग, प्र-सर्जन. See under
प्र-सृज्, p. 649, col. 2.

प्र-सर्ग, अस्, m., Ved. pouring forth, flowing
forth, efflux (Sāy. = वर्षण); emission, discharge.
प्रसर्प प्र-सर्प, &c. See प्र-सृप्, p. 649.

प्र-सर्प, अस्, m. going to the part of the
sacrificial enclosure called the Sadas; (अम्), n., N.
of a Sāman.

प्रसलवि प्र-सलवि, ind., Ved. towards
the right side, (opposed to अप-सलवि; also incor-
rectly written प्रसवि.)

प्रसव 1. 2. and 3. प्र-सव. See under
1. and 2. प्र-सु, col. 2, and 2. प्र-सू, p. 649.

1. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सु
below), Ved. pressing out Soma juice.

2. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 3. see under 2. प्र-सू,
p. 649), procreating, generating, procreation, genera-
tion; the production of young, bringing forth or bearing
[]
young, childbirth, parturition, delivery, travail, labour;
conception; birthplace, source, origin; offspring,
young, progeny, posterity, (अन्तः-प्˚, containing
offspring, pregnant; किसलय-प्˚, the offspring of a
twig, a young shoot); a flower, blossom [cf. कनक-
प्˚, पीत-प्˚]; fruit.
—प्रसव-गृह, अम्, n. a lying-
in chamber.
—प्रसव-धर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, charac-
terized by production, productive, prolific.
—प्र-
सव-बन्धन, अम्, n. the foot-stalk of a leaf or
flower, the leaf-stalk or peduncle.
—प्रसव-वि-
कार, अस्, m., Ved. a prodigy happening at the
birth of a child.
—प्रसव-वेदना, f. the pangs of
childbirth, throes.
—प्रसव-स्थली, f. ‘birthplace,’
a mother.
—प्रसव-स्थान, अम्, n. a receptacle for
young, a nest.
—प्रसवोत्थान (˚व-उत्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of the seventeenth Pari-śiṣṭa of the Yajur-veda.
—प्रसवोन्मुख (˚व-उन्˚), ई, f. expecting child-
birth, about to be delivered (according to Malli-
nātha = आसन्न-प्रसवा).

3. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 1. and 2. see under 1.
and 2. प्र-सु, p. 648), Ved. urging forwards, setting
in motion, being set in motion; a current, course,
stream; rousing up, excitement, animation; order-
ing, enjoining; furtherance, assistance, help; pursuit,
acquisition; one who urges on or excites.

प्रसव्य प्र-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards
the left, (opposed to प्र-दक्षिण); contrary,
reverse, reverted, inverted; favourable; (अम्), ind.
towards the left, to the left side.

प्राशव्य, आस्, m. pl. (fr. 3. प्राश् or प्राश), Ved.
food, provisions; (Sāy.) = साध्व्-अन्नादि, हितम्
अन्नादि, good or wholesome food, &c.

प्रसह् 1. प्र-सह्, cl. 1. A. -सहते, -सहि-
तुम्, -सोढुम्, to bear up against, be able to with-
stand, sustain, endure; to overpower, conquer, de-
feat; to make an effort; to be able (with inf.).

2. प्र-सह् or प्र-साह्, -साट्, m. (acc. प्र-साहम्),
overpowering; an epithet of Indra, (Sāy. = शत्रूणाम्
अभिभविता, the overcomer of foes); force, violence.
प्र-साह्. See 2. प्र-सह् above.

प्रासह् प्रा-सह्, ट्, f., Ved. power, force; प्रा-
सहा, by force, violently, mightily, (Sāy. = बलेन.)

प्र-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing up against, with-
standing; (अस्), m. a beast or bird of prey; endur-
ance, resistance (in दुष्-प्˚, q. v.); (आ), f. a kind
of Solanum (= वृहतिका).

प्र-साह, अस्, m. overpowering, defeating; con-
trolling one's self; अ-प्रसाह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. com-
pletely master of one's self, not subject to passion.
प्रसाह प्र-साह. See 1. प्र-सह्, col. 1.

प्रा-सह, अस्, m., Ved. power, force, (Sāy.) = श-
त्रूणाम् प्रकर्षेणाभिभविता; (आ), f., N. of
the wife of Indra.

प्रा-साह, अस्, आ, अम्, overpowering, subduing; ज-
गत्-प्रासाह, (in which) the Jagatīmetre predominates.

प्र-सहन, अस्, m. a beast or bird of prey;
(अम्), n. withstanding, resisting; overcoming, de-
feating; defeat; bearing, enduring; embracing, an
embrace.

1. प्र-सह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be resisted, to be
conquered or defeated; अ-प्रसह्य, not to be
resisted, irresistible.

2. प्र-सह्य, ind. having withstood, having sus-
tained; having overpowered or conquered; forcibly,
violently, by violence, by force; exceedingly.
—प्र-
सह्य-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting violently, violent in
action.
—प्रसह्य-चौर, अस्, m. ‘a violent thief,’
a robber, plunderer.
—प्रसह्य-हरण, अम्, n.
taking away by force, robbing, plundering; [cf. प्र-
सभ-हरण.]

प्र-सह्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. overpowering, defeat-
ing; an epithet of Indra.

प्रसातिका प्रसातिका, f. a kind of rice with
small grains (= अणु-व्रीहि; cf. प्र-साधिका).

प्रसाध् प्र-साध्, Caus. P. -साधयति, -यि-
तुम्, to accomplish, effect; to promote, advance,
further; to make one's own, acquire, (according to
Kullūka on Manu VII. 103 = आत्मसात्-कृ); to
subdue; to dress.

प्र-साधक, अस्, इका, अम्, accomplishing, per-
fecting, one who accomplishes or perfects; cleansing,
purifying; decorating, adorning, ornamenting; (अस्),
m. an attendant who dresses his master, a valet de
chambre; (इका), f. a female attendant who dresses
her mistress, lady's maid; wild rice; [cf. प्रसा-
तिका.]

प्र-साधन, अस्, ई, अम्, accomplishing, effecting;
one who accomplishes or effects (Ved.); (अस्), m. a
comb; (ई), f. a drug, commonly called सिद्धि; a
[]
comb, (केश-प्˚, a comb for the hair); (अम्), n.
bringing about, accomplishing, effecting; arranging;
setting in order; decorating, decoration, embellish-
ment, ornament, dress, toilet; a comb.
—प्रसा-
धन-विधि, इस्, m. a mode of decoration or em-
bellishment.
—प्रसाधन-विशेष, अस्, m. the
highest decoration, most excellent ornament.

प्र-साधित, अस्, आ, अम्, accomplished, finished,
completed, done; proved; ornamented, decorated.
—प्रसाधिताङ्ग (˚त-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having
the limbs ornamented or decorated.

प्र-साध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accomplished or
effected, practicable; to be destroyed; to be defeated.

प्रसिच् प्र-सिच्, Pass. -सिच्यते, to be poured
out or flow forth, to be scattered; to be lost.

प्र-सेक, अस्, m. flowing forth, flowing, dropping,
oozing; sprinkling, wetting; emission, discharge;
running or watering of the mouth or nose, flow of
saliva in vomiting, vomiting, sickness, nausea; the
bowl of a spoon or ladle.
—प्रसेक-ता, f. flow of
saliva in nausea or vomiting.

प्रसेक प्र-सेक, प्रसेकिन्. See under
प्र-सिच्, p. 648, col. 2.

प्रसेकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, discharging a fluid; suffering
from morbid flow of saliva.

प्रसिध् प्र-सिध्, cl. 4. P. -सिध्यति, -सेद्-
धुम्, to be accomplished or effected, to succeed; to
be gained or obtained; to be established; to be made
known or certified.

प्र-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, well known, notorious,
renowned, famous, celebrated; adorned, ornamented.
—प्रसिद्ध-क्षत्रिय-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, con-
sisting for the most part of renowned Kṣatriyas.
—प्रसिद्ध-ता, f. or प्रसिद्ध-त्व, अम्, n.
celebrity, the being well known, notoriety.

प्रसिद्धक, अस्, m., N. of a prince descended
from Janaka (a son of Maru and father of Kṛtti-
ratha).

प्र-सिद्धि, इस्, f. accomplishment, success, attain-
ment; the being generally known or admitted,
celebrity, fame, notoriety; ornament, decoration.
—प्रसिद्धि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, generally known,
notorious, famous.

प्रसीदिका प्रसीदिका, f. a small garden;
(also read प्रसेदिका, q. v.)

प्रसु 1. प्र-सु, cl. 5. P. A. -सुनोति, -सुनुते,
-सोतुम्, Ved. to press or squeeze out Soma juice,
extract the juice of the Soma plant (Sāy. = सोमा-
भिषवं कृ).

प्रसु 2. प्र-सु (sometimes written प्र-सू),
cl. 1. P., 2. 4. A. -सवति, -सूते, -सूयते (properly a
kind of reflexive passive form), -सोतुम्, -सवितुम्, to
procreate, beget, generate, engender; to bring forth,
be delivered of, bear: Pass. -सूयते (ep. also P. -ति),
to be begotten by (with abl.); to be brought forth
by, be born of (with loc.).

1. प्र-सू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ (for 2. see p. 649), bringing
forth, bearing [cf. पितृ-प्˚, पुत्रिका-प्˚, स्त्री-प्˚];
fruitful, productive; (ऊस्), f. a mother; a mare; a
young shoot, tender grass or herbs, sacrificial grass,
(Sāy. = प्रसवित्र्य् ओषधी); a spreading creeper,
the plantain.
—प्रसू-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, or प्रसू-
वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. furnished with flowers.

प्रसू 2. प्र-सू, cl. 6. P. -सुवति, -सवितुम्,
Ved. to urge forwards, incite, excite, animate.

प्राशु प्राशु (प्र-आशु), उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. (accord-
ing to the Nirukta = क्षिप्र), exceedingly quick or
speedy, swift; (Sāy.) = सोमस्य प्राशकः, an eater
or partaker of Soma; or = वृत्रस्य हिंसकः,
the enemy (or injurer) of Vṛtra.
—प्राशु-षह् or
प्राशु-षाह्, षाट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. leading or curbing swift
horses, having fleet horses; (Sāy.) = शीघ्रम् अभि-
भवितृ, rapidly victorious.
प्राशू प्राशू, ऊस्, m. = परा-क्रम.

प्र-सुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. flowing forth (as Soma from
the Soma press).
प्रसुत् प्र-सुत्. See under 1. प्र-सु, col. 2.

प्र-सुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. squeezing out or
extracting Soma juice.

प्र-सुव, अस्, m., Ved. pressing out Soma juice,
extraction of the juice of the Soma plant.
प्रसुव प्र-सुव. See 1. प्र-सु, p. 648, col. 2.

प्रसवक, अस्, m. the tree Buchanania Latifolia
(= पियाल).

प्र-सवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing forth, bearing;
(अन्ती), f. a woman in labour.

प्र-सवन, अम्, n. bringing forth, bearing
children, fecundity.

1. प्र-सवितृ, ता, m. (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सू,
p. 649), a procreator, generator, father; (त्री), f.
bringing forth, a mother.

2. प्र-सवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ (for 1. see p. 648,
col. 3), Ved. urging forwards, setting in motion, ex-
citing, animating; (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेणाभिज्ञातृ.)
प्र-सवीतृ, in the Ṛg-veda = 2. प्र-सवितृ.

1. प्र-सविन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 2. see under 2. प्र-
सू, p. 649), bringing forth, having or bearing young,
producing.

2. प्र-सविन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 1. see under 2. प्र-
सु, p. 648), urging forwards, exciting (?) .

प्र-सुत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought forth, born; (अस्
or अम्), m. or n. (?) , a particular high number; [cf.
महा-प्˚.]
प्रसुत प्र-सुत. See above.

प्र-सूत, अस्, आ, अम्, procreated, begotten, en-
gendered; brought forth, born, produced, grown;
begetting, engendering; one who has brought forth,
delivered; (अस्), m., N. of a class of deities under
Manu Cākṣuṣa; (अम्), n. a flower; any productive
source; (आ), f. a woman who has brought forth a
child, a woman recently delivered.
प्र-सूका, f. a mare.
प्रसूका प्र-सूका. See p. 648, col. 3.

1. प्र-सूति, इस्, f. procreating, procreation, beget-
ting, generating; bringing forth, bearing; calving;
laying eggs; birth, production, generation; coming
forth, growth (of fruits, flowers, leaves; cf. फल-
प्˚); a production, product; a procreator, begetter;
one who brings forth, a mother; offspring, children,
progeny; N. of a daughter of Maru and wife of
Dakṣa.
—प्रसूति-ज, अम्, n. ‘birth-produced,’ pain
or affliction (mental or corporeal) resulting as a ne-
cessary consequence of birth.
—प्रसूति-वायु, उस्,
m. air generated in the womb during the pangs of
travail.

2. प्र-सूति, इस्, f. (for 1. see under 2. प्र-सु),
urging forwards, impelling, commanding; permission.

प्रसूतिका, f. a woman who has had a child, a
woman recently delivered; = 1. प्र-सूति (at the end
of a comp., cf. नश्यत्-प्˚, सकृत्-प्˚).

प्रासूतिक प्रासूतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. प्र-
सूति), belonging or relating to childbirth.

प्र-सून, अस्, आ, अम्, born, produced; (अम्), n.
a flower; a bud, blossom; fruit.
—प्रसून-बाण
or प्रसून-वाण, अस्, m. ‘having flowers for
arrows,’ the god of love.
—प्रसून-वर्ष, अस्,
m. a shower of flowers (rained from heaven).
—प्रसूनाञ्जलि (˚न-अञ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, presenting
a nosegay of flowers held in both hands opened and
hollowed (= पुष्पाञ्जलि).
—प्रसूनेषु (˚न-
इषु), उस्, m. ‘flower-arrowed,’ an epithet of the
god of love.
प्रसूनक, अम्, n. a flower; a bud, blossom.

प्र-सूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being born (Mahā-bh.
Śānti-p. 5687).

प्रसुप् प्र-सुप्, प्र-सुप्त, प्र-सुप्ति. See
under प्र-स्वप्, p. 651, col. 1.

प्र-सुप्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. sleeping, asleep, slumber-
ing; (Sāy. = शत्रूणां हन्तृ.)

प्रसुश्रुत प्र-सुश्रुत, अस्, m., N. of a prince
(a son of Maru; cf. प्र-शुश्रुक).
प्रसुह्म प्र-सुह्म, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

प्रसृ प्र-सृ, cl. 1. and Ved. cl. 3. P. -स-
रति, -सिसर्ति, -सर्तुम्, to move forwards, go for-
ward, proceed, advance; to pass, pass by (as time);
to flow onwards, flow forth; to spring up; to break
forth, break out (as fire); to spread abroad; be
diffused; to be stretched forth, be extended, extend:
Caus. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go forwards,
move forwards, stretch forth, hold out; to spread
out, spread, extend; to expand, open wide; to put
forward, exhibit, expose (for sale).

प्र-सरण, अम्, n. going forth, running forth,
running away, escaping; going round; spreading
abroad, spreading over the country to forage; sur-
rounding an enemy; morbid displacement of the
humors of the body; complaisance, amiability.

प्र-सारण, अम्, n. causing to go forwards,
stretching out, extending, spreading, spreading abroad,
diffusing, diffusion, expanding, expansion, increase;
displaying, unfolding; going about; surrounding
an enemy; dispersion of an army by detachments
for collecting forage, &c.; changing a semivowel
into a vowel [cf. सम्-प्रसारण]; (ई), f. surround-
ing an enemy; a species of creeper, Pæderia Fœtida.

प्र-सरणि, इस्, or प्र-सरणी, f. surrounding an
enemy.

प्रसारणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, containing a semivowel
liable to be changed into a vowel.

प्र-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved forwards, held
out; stretched out, expanded, extended, spread, dif-
fused; laid out, exhibited, exposed (for sale).

प्र-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, coming forth, flowing forth,
moving on; going along gently, gliding, flowing,
creeping; stretching, extending; spreading forth,
spreading, expanding, expanded, unfolded; spread-
ing round; (इणी), f. the plant Pæderia Fœtida.

1. प्र-सार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be changed into a
vowel.

2. प्र-सार्य, ind. having stretched forth, having
put forth, having held out.

प्र-सृत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forwards, gone;
stretched out, stretched, extended; diffused, spread
abroad, dispersed; lengthened, long; swift, quick;
modest, humble; attached to, engaged in, appointed;
(अस्), m. the palm of the hand stretched out and hol-
lowed as if to hold liquids; a handful (as a measure,
= two Palas); (आ), f. the leg; (अम्), n. a measure
equal to two Palas; (प्र-सृत is sometimes incor-
rectly written for प्र-श्रित and even for प्र-सित,
q. q. v. v.)
—प्रसृत-ज, आस्, m. pl. an epithet of
a particular class of sons (Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p.
2615).

प्र-सृमर, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing forth, dropping,
distilling.
प्रसृमर प्र-सृमर. See above.

प्रसृज् प्र-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्,
to pour away; to lay aside, dismiss; to quit, leave,
abandon; to hurt, injure.

प्र-सर्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) throwing
or casting forth.

प्र-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, poured away, laid aside,
dismissed; hurt, injured; (आ), f. (probably) a par-
ticular movement in fighting.
प्रसृष्ट प्र-सृष्ट. See प्र-सृज् above.

प्रसृप् प्र-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्तुम्,
-स्रप्तुम्, to creep or crawl forth, creep on; to go
on, proceed.

प्र-सर्पक, अस्, m., Ved. an assistant who is
under the superintendance of the Ṛtvij at a sacrifice
or a mere spectator at a sacrifice (so designated
from entering the part of the sacrificial enclosure
called Sadas; cf. प्र-सृप्त); an uninvited guest,
an intruder (?) .
प्रासर्पक प्रासर्पक, अस्, m. = प्र-सर्पक.

प्र-सर्पण, अम्, n. going forwards, progressing,
entering (with loc.); entering the part of the sacri-
ficial ground called Sadas; refuge, shelter (Ved.;
Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण सर्पण-साधनम्).
प्र-सर्पत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, advancing, proceeding.

प्र-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creeping or crawling forth,
gliding away; coming forth, issuing; going to the
part of the sacrificial enclosure called Sadas.

प्र-सृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, crept or crawled forth,
crept away, come forth; entered into the part of the

पक, q. v.

प्रसेदिका प्रसेदिका, f. a various reading

प्रसेन प्र-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a prince (a

succeeded by Vikramārka or Vikramāditya.
—प्र-

sovereign of Śrāvastī contemporary with Śākya-muni.

a sack, a leathern bottle; a small instrument of wood
covered with leather and placed under the neck of
an Indian lute to render the sound deeper.

प्रासेव प्रा-सेव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सिव् with प्र),
Ved. a rope (forming part of a horse's harness).

प्रसेवक, अस्, m. a sack [cf. चर्म-प्˚]; a
particular part of a lute (= प्र-सेव); a crooked
piece of wood at the end of a lute.

Ṛṣi with the patronymic Kāṇva (according to the

प्रास्कण्व प्रास्कण्व, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or
relating to Pra-skaṇva; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.

प्रस्कन्द् प्र-स्कन्द्, cl. 1. P. -स्कन्दति, -स्कन्-

प्र-स्कन्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, springing forward,
springing forth.

प्र-स्कन्दन, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva (‘emit-
ting semen?’); (अम्), n. the act of leaping over, spring-
ing across; evacuation by stool, diarrhœa, dysentery.
प्र-स्कन्दिका, f. diarrhœa, dysentery.

प्र-स्कन्दिन्, ई, m., N. of a man possessed of
extraordinary strength.

प्र-स्कन्द्य, ind. having sprung forwards, having
leaped down, having quickly alighted.

प्र-स्कन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung forward, sprung
forth; dropped, fallen; defeated in battle; (अस्), m.

प्रस्कुन्द प्र-स्कुन्द, अस्, m. an altar or ele-
vated floor of a circular shape (= चक्राकारा वेदिका).

प्रस्खल् प्र-स्खल्, cl. 1. P. -स्खलति, -स्ख-

प्र-स्खलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, staggering forwards,

प्र-स्खलन, अम्, n. the act of staggering,
stumbling, tumbling, falling.

tation of the long and short vowels of a metre (?) ;

—प्रस्तरे-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (rt.

paring minerals; a bed made with blossoms and leaves;

thicket or wood overgrown with grass; a flat surface,

the possible combinations of certain given numbers

स्ताव).

consisting of 12 + 12 + 8 + 8 syllables.
प्र-स्तरण, अस्, आ, m. f. a couch, bed; a seat.

प्र-स्तरिणी, f. a species of small shrub (= गो-
लोमिका).

प्र-स्तारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, extending, spreading; (scil.
अर्मन्) a particular disease of the white of the eye.

प्र-स्तिर, अस्, m. a bed or couch made of flowers
and leaves (= प्र-स्तर).

प्र-स्तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, thrust forward, protruded (as
the tip of the tongue in pronouncing the dentals).

प्र-स्तृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread out, spread, ex-
tended; disappeared.

(fr. rt. स्त्यै with प्र), crowded together, clustering,
swarming; sounded, making a noise.

taka, and Ava-lagita).

प्र-स्तावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, beginning, com-
mencing.

प्र-स्तावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be told or

introduced with a Pra-stāva (as a Sāman).

cussion, revealed; said; expected, desired; ready,

tion.

sacrifice.

kind of metaphorical expression, allusion by the
mention of any passing circumstance to something

walking in a garden with an inconstant lover were

you can have the jasmine flower?).
प्र-स्तुति, इस्, f., Ved. praise, eulogium.

प्र-स्तुत्य, ind. having told or related, having
rehearsed.

प्रास्तुत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-स्तुत), the being pro-
pounded or discussed, the being under discussion.

प्र-स्तोतृ, ता, m., Ved. the Ud-gātṛ's assistant

प्रस्तोत्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the Pra-stotṛ.

son of Sṛñjaya; कुत्सस्य प्रस्तोकः, N. of a
Sāman.
प्रस्थल प्र-स्थल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

diment to proceeding or to dispatching (anything).

प्रस्थानिक, belonging or relating to a de-
parture, to a course, sect, &c.

cious to a departure; [cf. महा-प्˚.]

lating to a departure.

away, dismissed, sent, dispatched.

प्र-स्थेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set forth or departed.

प्र-स्नेय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be bathed in,

प्र-स्नव, अस्, m. dropping, a stream; pouring

प्र-स्नाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. pouring forth, dropping.

प्रस्नुषा प्र-स्नुषा, f. the wife of a grandson.

प्राश, अस्, m. eating, consuming, feeding upon,
tasting [cf. घृत-प्˚, धूम-प्˚]; food, victuals
[cf. चातुष्प्राश्य]; (occasionally incorrect) for प्रा-
स, q. v.

प्रास, अस्, m. casting, throwing; interspersing,
insertion; a barbed missile or dart; a particular
constellation or a particular position of a planet; N.
of a man.

प्राशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, eatable, edible, esculent,
serving for food; (अम्), n. food, victuals.

प्राशितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten, eatable,
edible, esculent, allowed to be eaten.

प्राशितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who eats, an eater,
eating.

प्राशित्र, अम्, n., Ved. the portion of Havis eaten
by the Brahman at a sacrifice; the vessel in which
the Brahman's portion of Havis is placed; anything
edible.
—प्राशित्र-हरण, अम्, n., Ved. a vessel in
which the Brahman's portion of Havis is placed.

प्राशित्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in अ-प्राशित्रिय, not
fit for the Prāśitra.

प्राशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) eating,
feeding upon; अमृत-प्राशिन्, ई, m. eating nectar,
a god.

प्राश्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, eating, consuming, de-
vouring.
1. प्राश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten, eatable, edible.

2. प्राश्य, ind. having eaten, having tasted or
sipped.

प्राश्य 1. and 2. प्राश्य. See under 2.
प्राश्, col. 2.

प्राशस्त्य प्राशस्त्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-शस्त),
the being praised, praiseworthiness, celebrity, excel-
lence, pre-eminence.

प्राशृङ्ग प्रा-शृङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having
projecting horns, having the horns bent forward;
(according to Mahī-dhara = प्रकृष्ट-श्रिङ्ग-
युक्त.)

प्राश्निक प्राश्निक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रश्न),
containing questions or inquiries [cf. बहु-प्˚]; (अस्),
m. an inquirer, asker, examiner; one who decides a
dispute or quarrel, an umpire, arbiter, arbitrator; an
assistant at a spectacle or assembly (?).
प्राश्नी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.

प्राश्वमेध प्राश्वमेध (प्र-अश्˚), अस्, m. a
preceding horse sacrifice.

प्रासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, armed with a dart or javelin;
(अस्), m. a spearman, lancer, javelin-man.
प्रासिक प्रासिक. See under 2. प्रास्, p. 660.

प्रासङ्गिक, अस्, ई, अम्, resulting from attach-
ment, proceeding from near relation, derived from
close connection; connected with, inseparably con-
nected, inherent, innate; pertaining to, belonging to
any topic, relevant; opportune, seasonable; occasion-
ally connected, occasional, incidental, casual, acci-
dental, (opposed to आधिकारिक); episodical.

प्रासङ्ग्य, अस्, गी (?), अम्, harnessed with a
yoke, yoked; (अस्), m. any animal used for draught,
a draught-ox or one yoked.

प्रासच प्रासच, अस्, m., Ved. a sudden and
violent shower of rain?; (ई), f. a flood of water
produced by sudden and violent showers of rain.

प्रासादिक, अस्, आ (?), अम् (fr. प्र-साद), kind,
amiable, friendly, favourable; given by way of
blessing, given as a favour; beautiful.

1. प्रासादीय, Nom. P. प्रासादीयति, &c., to
imagine one's self to be in a palace.

2. प्रासादीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a palace,
palatial.

प्रासेनजिती प्रासेनजिती, f. a patronymic
from Prasena-jit.

प्रास्तारिक प्रास्तारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
स्तार), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 4, 72.

प्रास्ताविक प्रास्ताविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
स्ताव), forming a commencement or introduction;
having a prelude (as a hymn, Ved.); useful on
occasion, suiting the subject under treatment; op-
portune.
